{{Quote|Aleudrupe berries are considered a delicacy on many worlds. Some of those who join our safaris insist in brining their own provisions. A few carelessly dropped seeds &mdash; We can only that the jungle itself will deal with such intrusions.|Falmal|<ref name="FC" />}}
The '''aleudrupe berry''' was a [[Berry/Legends|berry]] of the [[Yagaran aleudrupe plant]] and were considered to be a delicacy in many [[Star system/Legends|systems]].<ref name="FC" /> Originating from the [[Yagara system/Legends|Yagara system]],<ref name="Yagara" /> the berry had been introduced to the the [[Great Jungle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]]. When raised in the [[Fertilizer/Legends|fertilizing]] slime released by [[Morodin/Legends|Morodins]], the pits of the berries could be used as a catalyst along with [[promhassic triaxli]] and [[rethan-K]] to create a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Blaster gas/Legends|gas]] that was nearly as effective as spin-sealed [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas. The fruit, however, was completely normal and would pass any type of chemical testing. Since the berry, promhassic triaxli and rethan-K were all individually harmless and perfectly legal, they could pass customs inspection and be introduced onto politically volatile worlds. The [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]] [[Gamgalon]] ran a criminal enterprise masquerading as a Morodin hunting [[Gamgalon's Morodin-hunting safari|safari]] to secretly farm these berries, then transport them along with promhassic triaxli and rethan-K to politically tense planets. Gamgalon gained the profits of weapons smuggling with none of the inherent risk. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]], curious as to Gamgalon's operations on Varonat, ruined the operation<ref name="FC" /> in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
